item.subject: science
item.chapter_label: The night sky: Moon and calendars
item.stem: While watching the night sky from her rooftop in Jaipur, Meera notices a small star-like point of light moving steadily across the sky. Her grandfather says it could be an artificial satellite. Which statement about artificial satellites is correct?

options.A: Artificial satellites are natural objects like the Moon, so they can never be seen from the ground.
options.B: A moving point of light must be a star, because artificial satellites cannot be seen from the ground.
options.C: Artificial satellites are human-made objects that orbit Earth, and under suitable viewing conditions they can appear as tiny moving specks of light.
options.D: Old satellites and rocket parts burn up completely, so they never become space debris.
